systems.platform: single digital platform for civil registration, with mobile and Android applications
systems.tiers: over 12,025 registration points in 2025, at health facilities and community ward executive offices, through local government authorities; health workers send records by mobile phone to a central database

note: Birth registration is said to be decentralised through local government authorities to health facilities and ward executive offices; the ward is a sub-office, the slides name health workers' mobile phones as the device, and nothing is said of a connection at the council or ward office.
